name: Soft Bubbles
description: Translucent, overlapping bubbles in a mixed ink palette, softened into a hazy glow.

code.style: --rule: ( @place-cell: @r(5%, 95%) @r(5%, 95%); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { @size: @r(5%, 24%); border-radius: 50%; background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color4)) 0%, transparent 70%); mix-blend-mode: screen; opacity: @r(.45, .9); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
